info.description: One ability in the constellation on section 03. ⚠ ITS POSITION ON THE RING IS NOT HERE. The angle is evenly spaced around the circle and computed by the page from how many cards there are — 0°, 51°, 103° … for seven. It was stored once, and storing it meant an editor could move a node off the ring, or add an eighth card that overlapped the first.
